_comment: Phasor-FLIM, drawn by emtk. The Qt tool's AutoForm spec is phasor.view.json.

sections.title: Settings
sections.description: The source file, the phasor settings, the IRF reference, the detector window that is shown, the cursors and the actions.
Compute the maps, write them out, explore them or go on to the next step.

buttons.label: Run
buttons.description: Compute the phasor (g, s) and the photon counts of every detector window, in the background. Nothing is recomputed when neither the file, the windows, the reference nor the settings changed.

buttons.label: Add phasor to HDF5
buttons.description: Add the g and s columns of every window to the imaging HDF5 of the pipeline; when none is remembered a file is asked for.

buttons.label: Save container
buttons.description: Write the phasor table as a phasor artifact into the container beside the photon file (the Qt tool did this when it closed).

buttons.label: ndX
buttons.description: Explore the per-pixel table in ndX, the shared live dataset. A Back button returns to the maps.

buttons.label: Next
buttons.description: Remember the file and the HDF5 and go to the next analysis step. Only available inside the Imaging Tools pipeline.

sections.label: TTTR file
sections.placeholder: pick a file, drop one here, or load from the database
sections.description: PTU/HT3 imaging file with line and frame markers (or drop one onto the window: it is loaded and run). The scanner geometry is read from its header. Press Enter to select a typed path.
Pick the photon file from disk or from the database.

buttons.label: Browse
buttons.description: Browse for a photon imaging file on disk.

buttons.label: Database
buttons.description: Load a dataset registered in the database; the database resolves it to a local file wherever its object store keeps the data.

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: Minimum photons per pixel for a valid phasor; Run applies a changed value.

sections.label: Frequency (MHz, -1=auto)
sections.description: Modulation frequency in MHz; -1 derives it from the TTTR header. Run applies a changed value.

sections.label: View
sections.description: Bring any map or plot tab forward, also when the row of tabs is wider than the window.

sections.label: Detector window
sections.description: The detector window shown in the maps. Every window is computed and written; this only chooses which one is drawn. The windows come from the Detectors tab (or the Imaging Tools setup step); without any, the channel-0 window is used.

sections.title: IRF reference
sections.description: The instrument response of a detector window, used to calibrate its phasors. Inside the Imaging Tools pipeline it comes from the IRF & BG step.

sections.label: Window
sections.description: The detector window whose IRF is edited.

sections.label: IRF file
sections.placeholder: none: the raw phasor is computed
sections.description: Photon file of the instrument response of this window. Empty: the uncalibrated phasor. Press Enter to adopt a typed path.
Pick the IRF file.

buttons.label: Browse IRF
buttons.description: Browse for the IRF photon file of the chosen window.

buttons.label: Clear IRF
buttons.description: Remove the IRF reference of the chosen window: the uncalibrated phasor is computed.

sections.description: What was computed: the file, the size of the image and the detector windows.

sections.title: Phasor cursors
sections.description: Cursors on the (g, s) plane: draw an ellipse round a lifetime cluster, a polygon round one that is neither round nor elliptical, or several combined; Invert selects everything outside. The Selected tab shows the pixels they pick out.

sections.title: Intensity
sections.description: The summed photon counts per pixel of the displayed detector window.
